messages.text: Pulled the July cloud bill ahead of the review. Compute is up about 14% month over month, mostly the always-on Oracle instances behind ReconLegacy and the oversized PositionStore replicas.
14% is a lot. Is that the reserved instance coverage lapsing or actual usage growth?
Mix of both. Two RI commitments expired on the 15th and those boxes rolled to on-demand pricing. Usage itself is roughly flat.
For the review: PositionStore read replicas are provisioned for quarter-end peak but run at ~20% CPU the rest of the month. We could autoscale down to two replicas outside close windows.
Would scale-down cause replica lag when we scale back up? I remember the warmup taking a while last time we resized.
Yes, cold cache is the catch. Warmup was ~25 min in staging. I'd schedule the scale-up the evening before close, not reactive on load.
Separate item: ReconLegacy runs the Oracle 11g box 24/7 for a batch that finishes in about 90 minutes. Can we stop it between runs?
Licensing makes me nervous, and the Perl jobs assume the DB is always up. A stop/start wrapper is doable but I'd want Ravi's team to sign off since recon breaks land on them.
I can prototype the wrapper in dev this week. Start the instance 30 min before the batch, health check the listener, then shut down after the final recon export lands.
Please add a failure path too. If the batch hangs, the instance shouldn't auto-stop mid-run. Alert and leave it up.
Rough savings estimate: renewing the two RIs (1yr, no upfront) ~ $9k/month, PositionStore autoscaling ~ $5k/month, ReconLegacy scheduling ~ $3k/month. Total near $17k/month.
Renew the RIs first, that's the no-brainer. I'll file the purchase request today and tag Martin's team for approval.
Great. I'll put the other two as tickets with owners: Priya on PositionStore autoscaling, Travis on the ReconLegacy wrapper. Revisit at next week's review.
